Class LinkedSet<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • LinkedSet<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the type of elements maintained by this set
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<T>, java.util.Collection<T>, java.util.Set<T>
    public class LinkedSet<T>
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.util.Set<T>
    A custom implementation of the Set interface based on a singly linked list.

    This implementation does not allow duplicate elements and does not maintain any particular order of elements. It provides basic set operations such as adding, removing, checking containment, and iteration.

      • toArray

        public <E> E[] toArray​(E[] a)
        Returns an array containing all the elements in this set.

        If the provided array is large enough, the elements are stored in it. Otherwise, a new array of the same runtime type is created.

        If the array is larger than the size of the set, the element immediately following the last set element is set to null.

        Specified by:
        toArray in interface java.util.Collection<T>
        Specified by:
        toArray in interface java.util.Set<T>
        Type Parameters:
        E - the runtime type of the returned array.
        Returns:
        an array containing all elements of the set
        Throws:
        java.lang.NullPointerException - if the specified array is null
